  "rationale": "The supplied rule requires retaining drafts for 30 days. Users reportedly recreate drafts because “Delete draft” makes hiding look permanent. The proposed sequence makes the effect clear before activation, confirms it afterward, and places “Restore draft” beside the message. The verification plan checks recovery of the same draft and its contents, preservation of other drafts, screen-reader feedback, and keyboard access. Restore availability and duration remain unverified. The events show only reads, and the fixture snapshots match."
